title: This Desert Animal Never Drinks and Leaps 10 Feet
subject: jerboa

scenes.text: This tiny desert animal never needs a drink. And it hops like a kangaroo.
The jerboa. Its body is mouse-sized, and its tail is longer than the rest of it.
Alarmed, it can leap about ten feet in a single bound, and run up to 15 miles an hour.
Water? In the wild it gets all it needs from the roots and plants it eats, mostly at night when it's cool.
By day it hides in a burrow, and some species seal the entrance with soil to keep the moisture in.
So how does a desert animal survive with no water? It never needed any. It eats it.
